rule: A provider is not integrated merely because it has an API. Scrape-without-rights providers are rejected. Pricing and capabilities are recorded only when publicly documented; otherwise unknown.

providers.claimed_data_origin: First-party eBay completed sales, last 90 days
providers.licence_redistribution: eBay developer licence; Limited Release entitlement required
providers.marketplaces: eBay sites supported by the Buy APIs (IE/GB/DE/FR/IT/ES/US among others if entitled)
providers.uk_ie_eu_coverage: Yes if entitled and marketplace header is set
providers.pricing: Included in eBay developer programme if entitled; entitlement itself is restricted
providers.rate_limits: Not independently re-verified here; Buy API rate limits apply
providers.trial_availability: Not open to new users at this time (eBay current statement)
providers.tos_risk: Low if entitled and used per eBay ToS

providers.api_documentation: None. No public API. Internal Seller Hub endpoint is not a licensed integration surface.
providers.claimed_data_origin: eBay first-party sold and active research inside Seller Hub
providers.licence_redistribution: Seller-account research tool. No documented redistribution / automated API licence.
providers.marketplaces: Seller Hub marketplaces (US/GB/DE and others in the UI)
providers.uk_ie_eu_coverage: GB/DE/others in UI; IE coverage not independently confirmed as a distinct sold-ticket feed
providers.historical_depth: About 3 years of dashboard history (public descriptions; not re-measured here)
providers.individual_vs_aggregate: Primarily aggregated stats (average sold, sell-through, sold count). Per-listing research rows may appear in the UI; there is no official ticket-level bulk API.
providers.query_methods: Manual Seller Hub search. Owner may download/export whatever the UI permits.
providers.sku_gtin_support: Keyword / category in the UI. GTIN/ePID support in the dashboard is not independently documented here.
providers.pricing: Bundled with eBay seller/Store access; standalone API price does not exist
providers.trial_availability: Available to logged-in sellers in Seller Hub
providers.reliability: First-party for the owner looking at the screen
providers.tos_risk: High if browser-automated or if internal /sh/research/api/search is scraped. Permitted if the owner manually uses Seller Hub and uploads an export they are allowed to download.
providers.evidence_class_if_used: E for aggregates; ticket-level rows only when sold date+price exist in an owner export (never explode averages into fake tickets)

providers.historical_depth: Owner order history as exposed by Fulfillment
providers.sku_gtin_support: Line-item title / SKU on the owner's listings
providers.pricing: Free with eBay developer + owner consent
providers.trial_availability: Implemented; production last_ingest_count=0 (owner has no historical eBay sales)

providers.tos_risk: Calling a decommissioned API is wasted work

providers.claimed_data_origin: PriceCharting states they track video games sold on eBay and their own marketplace, then combine sold listings into one value per game and condition.
providers.licence_redistribution: Paid subscription API. ToS: personal/non-transferable licence; redistribution/commercial republishing restricted without authorisation.
providers.marketplaces: Video games, cards, collectibles — not cameras, phones, GPUs, DJ
providers.uk_ie_eu_coverage: Primarily USD/game-guide; Irish/EU camera coverage is not claimed
providers.historical_depth: Current guide prices via api/product; api/sales exists. Full historical tick series not independently confirmed here.
providers.individual_vs_aggregate: Mostly aggregated guide values; marketplace offers/sales for PriceCharting's own marketplace
providers.sku_gtin_support: PriceCharting product ids / console ids, not eBay ePID
providers.pricing: Paid subscription required for API token. Exact 2026 list price not independently confirmed in this pass (do not fabricate).
providers.rate_limits: Not independently documented in this pass
providers.trial_availability: Account is free; API requires paid subscription per their FAQ
providers.reliability: Legitimate first-party commercial product for games/collectibles
providers.tos_risk: Low if used under licence for in-app decisioning and not republished as a competing price guide
providers.evidence_class_if_used: G (guide) unless a documented ticket-level sold row is returned and licensed

providers.api_documentation: No official public developer API found. Instant sell/trade quotes are a website workflow (Re.Value).
providers.claimed_data_origin: MPB's own buy/sell book and Re.Value engine
providers.uk_ie_eu_coverage: UK/EU retail and trade-in. Strong camera coverage as a dealer, not as eBay sold tickets.
providers.historical_depth: Not a public historical sold-ticket archive
providers.individual_vs_aggregate: Live ask inventory and owner-initiated quotes. Quotes would be class D only if captured as an actual quote.
providers.query_methods: Website quote form. Third-party scrapers exist and are rejected.
providers.trial_availability: Anyone can request a quote in the browser
providers.reliability: Excellent as a dealer; not a market-wide sold feed
providers.tos_risk: High if scraped. Low if owner pastes a real quote they received.
providers.evidence_class_if_used: D only for an actual quote the owner records

providers.api_documentation: No official public KEH developer API found. Third-party 'KEH Camera API' wrappers scrape/search the storefront and are rejected.
providers.claimed_data_origin: KEH used inventory and Quote Wizard
providers.historical_depth: Current inventory, not eBay sold tickets
providers.reliability: Legitimate dealer; not a licensed sold-data API
providers.evidence_class_if_used: D/F/G depending on whether a real quote exists

providers.api_documentation: No official public developer API. ToS restrict commercial use and republication of Content.
providers.claimed_data_origin: Historical sold comps / price guide, antiques and collectibles emphasis
providers.licence_redistribution: Membership licence for personal research; commercial use of Content prohibited by ToS
providers.marketplaces: Collectibles / antiques; not a cameras/phones/GPU sold API
providers.uk_ie_eu_coverage: Not a documented Irish electronics sold feed
providers.historical_depth: Long archive (marketing claim); not independently measured here
providers.individual_vs_aggregate: Price guide / sold comps in the product UI
providers.pricing: Membership tiers publicly advertised historically; current 2026 exact API price n/a because there is no official API
providers.reliability: Not usable as a licensed electronics sold API
providers.tos_risk: High for commercial resale-arbitrage reuse; scraping prohibited in spirit of ToS

providers.provider: SoldComps / Apify eBay sold scrapers / RapidAPI eBay sold / Anysite / ShopAPIS / Terapeak MCP browser wrappers
providers.api_documentation: Third-party; they advertise themselves as sold-data APIs because Marketplace Insights is closed
providers.claimed_data_origin: eBay sold/completed HTML or feedback, or Seller Hub internals
providers.historical_depth: Typically ~90 days of public sold search, or whatever HTML remains

providers.claimed_data_origin: Official Scryfall API; Cardmarket EUR as a dealer/market guide
providers.uk_ie_eu_coverage: EUR guide, not Irish realised tickets
providers.reliability: High as a guide; not realised Irish sales

providers.trial_availability: Already wired; 4 listings in production baseline
